decision: Owner 2026-10-27: Temporal = SELF-HOST on fleet infrastructure (Cloud free tier not permanent; card rule). Integration finished as a standing self-host, not a per-pass dev server.

deployment.server: Temporal dev-server mode, CLI 1.9.1 / Server 1.32.0, single node, systemd units temporal-selfhost + temporal-relay (Restart=always)
deployment.persistence: sqlite DB on durable workspace disk (~/workspace/temporal-selfhost/temporal.db)
deployment.recovery: hourly keepalive job reinstalls units from workspace copies after VM replacement (install.sh); /etc does not persist

reproof.result: both proof workflows still list Completed from the sqlite DB after systemctl restart

named_limits: Sandbox host link (host0 198.19.0.2) garbles gRPC HTTP/2 preface through any relay (reproduced with socat + python relays) — the fault is the link; a clean mesh interface carries the relay.
Single node: multi-node Temporal clustering not claimed. Redundancy = persistence + supervision + relay + reinstall recovery.
Dev-server mode (sqlite) is the fleet's operating point per the pass; a Postgres-backed cluster is a future migration, not this integration's scope.
